title: ISO8583: Const-ify "struct iso_type" instances.
description:
Moves 3 kBytes of data from a read-write section to a read-only section.

While we're here, clean up an unnecessary static variable named "data_array".
It can easily become a local variable (with a more descriptive name) which we
can pass into functions as needed.
